node.title: KoalaBear active balanced-core witness to Q6 endpoint realization
node.statement: For every canonical source certificate emitted by rate_half_kb_active_balanced_core_witness_compiler, prove the equality-wall Q=6,s=6,u=2 hypotheses and construct on the same received line an actual endpoint record and residual component. Preserve the certificate's affine slope, selected support, explaining data, and first-match owner; keep the endpoint parameter line distinct from the evaluation carrier; and print an injection or exact finite multiplicity for every certificate-to-record and record-to-component fiber.
node.falsifier: A valid active balanced-core source certificate that does not satisfy the Q6,s6,u2 endpoint hypotheses, has no actual residual component, changes owner/support/slope, conflates parameter and carrier coordinates, or has an uncontrolled realization fiber.
